question: Can an independently trained per-pixel door semantic source separate actionable glass-door hypotheses from no-portal current views well enough to justify a fresh SCIL-to-portal confirmation?

representation.name: Semantic Portal Presence Field
representation.change_from_pb5: Replace hand-crafted vertical-line opportunity admission with a two-class per-pixel background/door semantic field trained without PB1-PB6 images. Connected door components are the only authorizable portal candidates.
representation.pb1_separation: PB1 compared portal crops and facade/global appearance with the requested building. SPPF receives no target name, reference image, SCIL score, or place identity; it answers only whether door-class pixels form a sufficiently large component.

model.training_role: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY independent public/synthetic door semantic training; no PB1-PB6 pixel or identity input

runtime.backend_selection: Warm one equivalent CPU and CUDA inference, time one inference on each, and choose the faster backend; CUDA wins a tie.
runtime.component_extraction: Raw eight-connected components of the predicted door class; no morphology, crop, prompt, TTA, or model ensemble. Rank by door-pixel area and retain at most 20 per frame.

development_cohort.positives: All six previously frozen source-disjoint glass-door portal-lattice-fresh-v3 frames and their pre-existing human portal-set boxes.
development_cohort.negatives: All sixteen target-local-v1 rows frozen as no distinct actionable entrance before that route's model call.
development_cohort.excluded_from_selection: The four broad target-local-v1 positive apertures are not used because they mix fare gates, open arches, and corridor doors outside the narrow glass-door confirmation target.

candidate_membership: A semantic component is a positive portal member when its box center lies inside the frozen portal-set region and at least half of its box area lies inside that region.
threshold_selection: Enumerate only observed Development component-area fractions plus zero and the next value above the maximum. Among thresholds retaining truth in at least four of six positive frames at Top-3 and falsely authorizing at most two of sixteen no-portal frames, minimize false-authorized negative frames, then maximize positive truth retention, then choose the largest threshold. If none qualifies, close the semantic source without a fresh confirmation.
stop_rule: Run this Development selection once. After output, do not alter source labels, model, component connectivity, membership, threshold candidates, selection order, or gate on these rows. A passing Development result may only freeze a source-disjoint PB6 confirmation; it is not itself promotion evidence.
next_step: If the Development gate passes, freeze the selected area threshold and run once on new entities with same-frame SCIL opportunity, in-scope doors, no-portal controls, and open-aperture OOD controls. If it fails, close this model and change the semantic source.
claim_boundary: Algorithm-fresh Development reuse of consumed public-image cohorts. A pass only establishes that a separate semantic door field is worth source-disjoint confirmation. It does not bind a requested entity, establish portal ownership, public access, opening state, traversability, active-view causality, guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
